**What you ran** (the exact command or skill, and where: Claude Code conversation or terminal)

**What you expected** (quote the README or the skill text if you can)

**What happened** (paste the output; if a guardian printed a message, paste it whole)

**Your setup**: Claude Code version (`claude --version`), plugin version (`plugins/toem/.claude-plugin/plugin.json`), OS and shell, Python version.

**Files** — if it helps, the relevant lines of your `CONSTITUTION.md`, `PENDING.md` or `CORRESPONDENCE.md`, with anything private removed. Never paste credentials or hostnames.
